data.name: Blueshift APIs
data.description:
These APIs will help you manage different workflows in Blueshift. Our powerful REST APIs provide an easy way to integrate your data and third party applications with Blueshift.

Contact Support:
 Email: support@getblueshift.com

folders.name: Data validation
folders.description: Export data to validate or get counts.

folders.name: Live content
folders.description: Use the Live content API endpoint to insert content recommendations in your website and mobile apps.

folders.name: Push template
folders.description: Push template lifecycle management

folders.name: Promotions
folders.description: Promotions allows you to manage promo codes that you may wish to send to your customers through Blueshift Campaigns

folders.name: External fetch
folders.description: External fetch is a Blueshift capability that lets you include dynamic content from external servers that is fetched “just in time” before sending a message.

folders.name: Catalog
folders.description: A catalog is a list of items which may include content or products.

folders.name: Segments
folders.description: A segment is a list of users that satisfy a criteria. For example, you can create a segment for users who are located in the San Francisco area and run campaigns for them.

folders.name: Customer
folders.description: Blueshift hosts 360 degree customer profile for each of your users to represent all of their demographic, behavioral and engagement activity.

folders.name: Search
folders.description: You can use the `customer_search` API to search for events associated with a customer.

folders.name: Shared assets
folders.description: Manage reusable assets such as HTML, rich text, subject lines, and visual editor content.

folders.name: Campaigns
folders.description: Manage your campaigns in Blueshift.

folders.name: Event
folders.description: Use the event APIs to send events from your servers.

folders.name: Custom user lists
folders.description: A custom user list contains information about the users of your site such as name, email, phone number, and location. You can use this list as a segment and run campaigns for them.

folders.name: Tags
folders.description: Tags are folder-based entities that you can use to organize your resources. Each tag folder contains its own isolated set of tags.

folders.name: Email validation
folders.description: Validate single or bulk email addresses to assess deliverability and risk.

folders.name: Adapters
folders.description: Adapters are entities that provide integration to various services with Blueshift. For example, we provide adapters for various services such as Mailgun, Sendgrid, and Sparkpost for sending emails, and Infobip and Attentive adapters for SMSes. Similarly, we provide adapters for various channels and integrations.

folders.name: SMS template
folders.description: SMS template lifecycle management

folders.name: Subscription groups
folders.description: Retrieve subscription groups and view detailed information for each subscription group.

folders.name: Email template
folders.description: Email template lifecycle management

folders.name: Customer groups
folders.description: Customer groups link multiple customer profiles to a common parent entity with shared attributes. Use these endpoints to delete a group or remove a user from a group.

folders.name: Interest alerts
folders.description: Interest alerts store information about users' interests. When an event occurs in an area or topic in which multiple users are interested, you can trigger a single API call to send a notification to all the users who are interested in that topic.

requests.name: Validate multiple email addresses
requests.description: Use this endpoint to validate up to 30 email addresses. This feature requires custom setup. Contact Blueshift Support or your CSM to enable it.

requests.name: Bulk create/update customer
requests.description: Use this endpoint to create or update details of multiple customers.

requests.description: Use this endpoint to permanently delete all personal data associated with a customer and remove them from tracking.

requests.name: Start tracking a customer
requests.description: Use this endpoint to start tracking a customer. After tracking is enabled, the customer becomes eligible for future campaigns.

requests.name: Trigger customer import
requests.description: Triggers a launched S3 customer attributes import task.

requests.description: Use this endpoint to create a shared asset.

requests.name: Start a Live Activity
requests.description: Starts a Live Activity on one or more customers' devices.

requests.description: Use this endpoint to get the seed lists from your account.

requests.name: Merge customers
requests.description: Use this endpoint to programmatically merge two duplicate customers, effectively unifying them as one.

requests.name: Live content
requests.description: Use this endpoint to insert content recommendations in your website and mobile apps.

requests.name: Update a Live Activity

You can get the template UUID from the URL when you view a template in the Blueshift app. For example, in `https://app.getblueshift.com/dashboard#/app/external_fetches/<TEMPLATE_UUID>/edit`, the <TEMPLATE_UUID> is the uuid that you need.

requests.name: Bulk remove users from list
requests.description: Bulk remove users from a custom list — up to 25 per call, or 500 with `async=true`.

queryParams.description: Set this parameter to `true` to remove users from the list asynchronously. In async mode, you can send up to 500 identifier values in one API call, and the request runs in the background after it is accepted. Omit this parameter or set it to `false` to remove users synchronously, where you can send up to 25 identifier values in one API call. The response format is the same in both modes.

pathVariableData.description: Specify the ID of the list from which you want to remove users in bulk.

queryParams.description:
Determines whether the users associated with the group are also deleted.

- `false` — Deletes the group and preserves all associated user records.
- `true` — Deletes the group and permanently removes all associated users. (This can only be one of false,true)

pathVariableData.description: The ID of the customer group to delete. This is not the UUID.

requests.name: List tags and tag folders
requests.description: Use this endpoint to list all the tags and tag folders in your Blueshift account.

queryParams.description:
Filter by resource type (e.g., `Campaign`, `Segment`, `Template:EmailTemplate`, `SharedAsset`, `Syndication`).

**Note:** Must exactly match the resource type. Not required when using `resource_uuid` since UUIDs are unique across all resource types.

Filter tags for a specific resource by its UUID. **No need to specify `resource_type` when using UUID** - UUIDs are unique across all resources.

**Finding the UUID:**
• Campaign: `https://app.getblueshift.com/dashboard#/app/campaigns/<CAMPAIGN_UUID>/details`
• Segment: `https://app.getblueshift.com/dashboard#/app/segments/<SEGMENT_UUID>/edit/events`
• Template: `https://app.getblueshift.com/dashboard#/app/templates/<TEMPLATE_UUID>/edit`

Returns empty array `[]` if UUID doesn't exist or has no tags.

requests.name: List adapters
requests.description: Use this endpoint to list all adapters in your Blueshift account. Adapters connect your account to third-party services (e.g., Mailgun for email, Infobip for SMS), and you may have multiple per channel.

queryParams.description:
(Required) Specify the channel type to filter adapters:

• `Email` - Email service providers (e.g., Sendgrid, Mailgun)
• `SMS` - SMS service providers (e.g., Twilio, 46elks)
• `Push Message` - Push notification providers
• `Webhook` - Webhook integrations
• `InApp` - In-app message providers
• `Segment Report` - Segment reporting integrations (This can only be one of Email,SMS,Push Message,Webhook,InApp,Segment Report)
Filter results by adapter provider name (e.g., `sendgrid`, `sparkpost`, `46elks`, `twilio`).
